summary: Perella Weinberg Partners filed an 8-K reporting that certain stockholders may resell 1,127,529 shares of Class A common stock via a prospectus supplement to an effective S-3ASR registration statement. The shares were issued pursuant to a Sale and Purchase Deed dated April 13, 2026, as amended, among the company and sellers. The filing includes a Mayer Brown legal opinion on share legality. This is a routine resale registration event, not a special situation. No premium, deal terms, or strategic implications are present. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; merely a secondary offering registration.
